subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should the remaining independent-media batching work be implemented as plugin-owned opt-in buffering for affected channels, a generic channel SDK/gateway coalescer, or deferred in favor of existing text debounce plus narrow channel fixes?
rationale: The remaining behavior changes public config, latency, reply-token timing, channel lifecycle semantics, and plugin/core ownership, so automation should not choose the permanent product/API direction.

options.title: Plugin-owned opt-in buffers
options.body: Implement opt-in sender/conversation-scoped media batching in affected channel plugins first, sharing SDK helpers only when a common contract is clearly needed.

options.title: Generic SDK/gateway coalescer
options.body: Design a shared media coalescing contract before channel-specific implementation, accepting broader API, config, and compatibility review.

options.title: Defer broad batching
options.body: Keep text debounce and Telegram album handling as supported behavior and handle only narrower channel bugs such as WhatsApp steer media loss.

recommendation.title: Plugin-owned opt-in buffers
recommendation.body: Implement opt-in sender/conversation-scoped media batching in affected channel plugins first, sharing SDK helpers only when a common contract is clearly needed.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans shared debounce policy, plugin boundaries, and config compatibility, and history ties this owner to those surfaces.
